title.en: A Conversation That Changed My Mind
title.zh: 改變我想法的一段對話

subtitle: 記錄一次讓你改變看法的對話
task: Write a diary entry about a conversation that changed your mind about something. What did you believe before, what did the other person say, and what do you think now?
taskZh: 寫一篇日記，記錄一段讓你改變想法的對話：你原本怎麼想？對方說了什麼？你現在又怎麼想？
focus: 清楚對比「以前的想法」與「現在的想法」
用間接引述轉述對方說的話
用過去式敘事，用現在式寫現在的想法

en: Until today, I thought my grandmother's stories were boring. Whenever she started talking about her childhood, I usually looked at my phone. This afternoon, however, I helped her clean the cupboards, and we had a long talk.

She told me that she had left school at twelve to work in a tea factory. She said she used to read her brother's old textbooks at night because she wanted to keep learning. I was surprised, because I had never asked her about it.
Now I realize that her stories are not boring at all. They are part of my family's history. Next weekend, I plan to record her stories so that I never forget them.
zh: 直到今天以前，我都覺得奶奶的故事很無聊。每次她開始講小時候的事，我通常都在滑手機。不過今天下午，我幫她整理櫥櫃，我們聊了很久。
她告訴我，她十二歲就離開學校，到茶廠工作。她說她以前晚上會讀哥哥的舊課本，因為她想繼續學習。我很驚訝，因為我從來沒問過她這些事。
現在我明白，她的故事一點也不無聊。它們是我們家族歷史的一部分。下個週末，我打算把她的故事錄下來，這樣我就永遠不會忘記。

patterns.zh: 直到今天以前，我都以為……（帶出想法的改變）
patterns.example: Until today, I thought my grandmother's stories were boring.

patterns.pattern: She told me that she had …
patterns.zh: 間接引述＋過去完成式：轉述更早發生的事
patterns.example: She told me that she had left school at twelve to work in a tea factory.

patterns.zh: used to：過去常做、現在不再做的事
patterns.example: She said she used to read her brother's old textbooks at night because she wanted to keep learning.
Next weekend, I plan to record her stories so that I never forget them.
